roadmapTask: Extract boky's existing extension↔WebSocket-relay↔MCP devtools bridge into a standalone, boky-free Chrome-control tool inside this repo, usable by any MCP-capable terminal AI coding tool (Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Claude Code) without a Claude account. First version: core page actions (navigate, getPageText, readPage, findElement, clickElement, typeText, captureTab) plus page console-log and network-request capture queryable from MCP tools. Works locally from this repo via a script + MCP config entry; not published. Boky itself keeps working unchanged.
